said.todayNone: Nothing in your data meets a timeline check today. Silence does not mean all is well.
said.todayMore: 3 more ANDAs in News and alerts.
said.copied: Copied the summary: 2 immediate, 1 longer term. Please read it before you send it.
said.calendar: 4 goal dates in the next 180 days. In the Windows app, Save writes this as a calendar file (.ics) where you choose, and Outlook can open it; it holds each ANDA number and its goal date, nothing else. This page cannot save files, so the text is below.
said.hint: The timeline checks run on this PC over your own sheet and to-do list, by fixed rules, with no AI. They say what the data shows and never decide. They appear in Today and in News and alerts, and near the clock when the notices are on. The check for an unchanged status counts from the day this tool first sees each status, so it says nothing in its first weeks.

items: Timeline checks watch your goal dates by fixed rules, with no AI: immediate (a goal date passed or close, a forecast after the goal, no forecast, a to-do item due, a goal date moved earlier) and longer term (a forecast that slipped, a thin margin, a crunch week, a status unchanged for a month). Each limit is in Settings, How it starts.

Today lists what needs a look first, in one group, most urgent first. News and alerts shows the immediate and the longer term apart, copies a summary for a team lead, and gives the goal dates as a calendar file.
The Windows app now shows the short notices near the clock and the division news, off until you switch them on.
